skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the objectives, significance, research methods, types of data, and ways to collect data for international economic research.
Recognize the objective and significance of international economic research.
Familiar with the research methods of international economics.
Understand the techniques for collecting data for international economic research.
Understand the objective trends, laws, and impacts of international relations.
Understand the basis for forming theoretical models of international trade and investment and their significance in international economic activities.
Understand the basis for forming, developing, and impacting international economic relations.
Apply theoretical knowledge to analyze international economic relations and tools of international trade policy.
Have the ability to work independently and in groups to solve requirements in study and work assignments.
Analyze the social context, corporate social responsibility, and ethical awareness.

Have the ability to self-study, understand materials to complete assigned lessons and assignments, have a sense of classroom discipline, follow classroom rules, and have a spirit of cooperation and personal responsibility for activities assigned by the instructor.
Recognize the social context, professional ethics, and social responsibility.
